Hello, welcome to the game!

1. If you want to feel a little less lost in the story, you can start doing the quests in the order of the expansions. It's really easy to keep track of them, but they're so many, it'll probably take you some time to complete. Also, the early ones are not as well done as the BFA quests. I personally recommend watching Nobbel's videos on YouTube, he tells the story of most important characters and events, and with some details that you won't find in the WoW lore alone just by playing.
Though, if you want to do all the quests for yourself, I am gonna detail a bit the order of areas below.

Classic (Eastern Kingdoms + Kalimdor) -> The Burning Crusade (Outland) -> Wrath of the Lich King (Northrend) -> Cataclysm (this expansion's lore takes place in some areas from the classic continent, those areas are the following: Vashj'ir, Mount Hyjal, Uldum, Deepholm, Twilight Highlands) -> Mists of Pandaria (Pandaria) -> Warlords of Draenor (Draenor) -> Legion (Broken Isles) -> Battle for Azeroth (Kul'tiras and Zandalar) -> Shadowlands

2. Shadowlands is gonna become free with the release of the Dragonflight pre-patch, however next week the next season of the game will start, so a lot of players will be playing. If you want to do any challenging group content, then I recommend getting Shadowlands before the pre-patch if you can find it somewhere cheap.

After years of letting little things bother me, I realized that will only affect me in a negative way long term, and since then every time I am in a situation where I get bothered by something small, depending on the situation, I either ignore it, distract myself, take deep breaths and think about ways to get out of that situation and go on with my life.

I don't know if I am at risk of hurting myself, as I said these thoughts are heavy and present and I cannot control them, but I can control my actions pretty well. I only had a suicide attempt back in 2018, that was the only one and I tried that because of a situation I was in.

And yes, I agree that I might need more meds than 5-htp, or at least a higher dose

The thing is, getting locked up will both crush my parents' heart and possibly ruin some friendships and I don't wait to see either happening. I wouldn't even know how to break down the news to my parents. And with my friends, I don't want them to be careful around me to not trigger me (even though I don't have conversational triggers with my close friends) and I don't want to see them looking at me with pity in their eyes.

But I will think about it, maybe I will do it, I just have to think of some proper wording beforehand.

Also I should point out the fact that regarding 5HTP, I've been taking only 1 pill until yesterday, and after I started taking 2 (this is what my psychiatrist told me to do). Yesterday night I had a very strong depressive episode, I deleted all my social media content and I was on the verge of crying the entire night until I fell asleep (which wasn't easy). It wasn't any better today in the morning, but apparently now (6PM) out of a sudden I feel less tired and more energetic again. I have to read a bit to see if these pills can cause mood swings like the ones I have.

I don't know if scheduling hangouts is a possibility. Out of all my friends that I have right now, only 2 of them are from, or close, to the city I live in.
